---
title: "How to Beat Warren Buffett"
date: "2007-06-16"
categories: ["Economics", "Financial Markets"]
---

It’s as easy as investing in Australian banks:

> *Research from global consulting firm Stern Stewart, commissioned by [The Australian](http://www.theaustralian.news.com.au/story/0,20867,21913057-643,00.html "The Australian"), shows the banks beat Buffett in terms of total shareholder return (share price growth plus dividends) over one, three, five, 10 and 15 years.*
